promises.promise: Said she will continue to support workers, jobs and job-training resources.

promises.promise: Said she will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.
promises.quote:
The truth about Annie Andrews: Her primary profession is as a gun control activist.  She wants to gut the Second Amendment and confiscate firearms from law-abiding citizens. 

I will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to defend homeschooling parents.
promises.quote: The government does not get to choose what’s best for our kids. Parents have every right to choose a faith-based curriculum for their children. I urge the Supreme Court to reverse the California court’s discriminatory decision. I will continue to defend homeschooling parents.

I will fight hard to pass this bill into law.

promises.promise: Said he intends to keep voting to assert Congress's constitutional role and power of the purse.
promises.quote: So as the question of how we will conduct ourselves going forward in Cuba, in Ukraine, in the Middle East is before this body, I intend to continue to vote for the Congress to take its constitutional role and, more than anything, for us to not hand away the power of the purse to an overreaching President.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on expanding warrantless FISA surveillance powers.

The Trump Administration is using FISA to spy on you without a warrant—arming Trump’s lawless federal agents with mountains of data, completely unchecked. 
  
I will vote NO on giving Donald Trump and his cronies more power to spy on Americans.

I will vote to support @POTUS and give him all the tools available to defend America’s interests.

I will continue to support DHS funding to ensure our immigration laws are enforced and Nebraskans are safe.

President Trump, Kristi Noem, and Stephen Miller are making our communities and all Americans less safe. Enough is enough.

Glad my bill with @SenTedCruz has passed the Senate and is on to the House.

I will ALWAYS stand up and fight for Alabama’s shrimpers and fishermen.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented.
promises.quote: I will not stop working until the Social Security Fairness Act is implemented and state and local public servants get the Social Security benefits they deserve.
promises.assessment: Kept pressing until the agency reported implementation complete. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Called with Sen. Collins for immediate implementation of the Social Security Fairness Act.
The Social Security Administration reported it had completed over 3.1 million payments under the law, ahead of schedule. Some advocates questioned whether every case was finished.

promises.promise: Said he will work to reverse the Trump administration's effort to eliminate BEACH Act funding.
promises.quote: No one wants to swim at a polluted beach. Federal BEACH Act funding tests water quality & keeps the public well-informed – boosting public health, environmental health, & economic health. I oppose the Trump Admin’s effort to eliminate BEACH funding & will work to reverse it.

promises.promise: Said he would introduce legislation the following week to end birthright citizenship for children of illegal immigrants.
promises.quote:
Unlike liberal activists judges, President Trump was elected to secure our border and deport those who shouldn’t be here. 

Next week I will introduce legislation to end birthright citizenship for illegal immigrants once and for all.
promises.assessment: Promised to introduce the bill the following week and did. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 2274, the Constitutional Citizenship Clarification Act, to end birthright citizenship for children of people in the U.S. illegally, five days after the pledge.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no on the “Big Beautiful Bill.”
promises.quote: The “Big Beautiful Bill” is a giveaway to billionaires on the backs of the working class. I will vote hell no.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on passage of H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. It passed 51–50 with the Vice President breaking a 50–50 tie.

promises.promise: Said he will continue to oppose the sale of federal public lands.
promises.quote: I always have and always will be against the sale of public lands. @TimSheehyMT & I worked together to block this provision from being included in the Senate reconciliation bill and I will always fight for our MT outdoor way of life.

promises.promise: Said she and Democratic colleagues would continue fighting to fund and improve public schools.
promises.quote: So my Democratic colleagues and I will continue to fight to fund quality public schools, to improve public education in this country-- foundational.

promises.promise: Said he would move his amendment concerning U.S. military action against Iran if the Senate takes up the resolution.
promises.quote: And if the Senate votes to bring this resolution before the body, which I hope it will see the wisdom of doing, I will move an amendment that I have filed with Senators Kim and Kaine that I would hope would receive all of our support.
promises.assessment: This promise depended on the Senate taking up the resolution. It didn't, so the condition was never met. Left as not started. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: The motion to bring up S.J.Res. 59, the Iran war powers resolution, failed 47–53 (Schiff voted yes), so the resolution never reached the stage where his amendment could be offered.

promises.promise: Said he would seek to block arms sales announced during the trip to countries investing personally in President Trump and his family.
promises.quote: I will personally seek to block any arms sale that is announced as part of this trip with a country that is personally investing in Donald Trump and his family.
promises.assessment: He said he'd try to block the arms sales, not that he would succeed. He introduced a resolution against the Qatar sale and forced floor votes on the Qatar and UAE sales; both failed. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records and Congress.gov.

evidence.description: Introduced S.J.Res. 53 to block a proposed arms sale to Qatar, one of the countries on the President's May 2025 trip.
Voted to discharge S.J.Res. 53 (Qatar arms sale); the motion failed 39–56.
Voted to discharge S.J.Res. 54 (UAE arms sale); the motion failed 39–56.

promises.promise: Said he would not expedite State Department nominations until the administration complies with the law and is accountable to Congress.
promises.quote: So I will not expedite confirmation of State Department nominees until and unless this administration starts complying with the law and being accountable to Congress.

promises.promise: Said he will oppose any Trump administration attempt to cut Social Security.
promises.quote:
Americans pay into Social Security their entire lives. They deserve their benefits, full stop.

I will fight any and all attempts by President Trump and his Administration to cut Social Security.

promises.promise: Said he will always oppose taxpayer funding of abortion.
promises.quote:
ZERO taxpayer dollars should be used to pay for abortions.

Every life is sacred, and I will always fight for the unborn and the taxpayers.

promises.promise: Said he will oppose future efforts to change the law Congress already passed on the matter at issue.
promises.quote: So I do oppose this effort to change the law, and I will oppose, in the future, other efforts to change the law that Congress already passed.

promises.promise: Said he will vote against the Kaine resolution on tariffs.
promises.quote:
Nope, this story is wrong. I was not talking about the Kaine resolution, which I will be voting against. 

Tariffs must be executed with precision to protect North Carolina farmers and businesses who have been hurt by bad trade policies before, including NAFTA.
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote against the Kaine resolution and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on S.J.Res. 37, Sen. Kaine's resolution to end the national emergency used for tariffs on Canada. It passed 51–48.

promises.promise: Said he and twenty colleagues would introduce legislation against universal injunctions.
promises.quote: Mr. President, today, 20 of my colleagues and I will introduce legislation to stop the abuse of universal injunctions that we are seeing all across the country--all of this to stop the Trump agenda.
promises.assessment: Said he would introduce the bill that day; S. 1206 was introduced on March 31, 2025. Assessed by Claude from the bill text on GovInfo and the committee announcement.

evidence.description: Introduced S. 1206, the Judicial Relief Clarification Act of 2025, to limit nationwide injunctions, the same day as the speech.
Senate Judiciary Committee announcement of the bill.

promises.promise: Said she will support law enforcement on border security and fentanyl.
promises.quote: I will always have their backs as we work together to secure the border, end the fentanyl crisis, strengthen our national security, and protect Florida families.

promises.promise: Said he would oppose weakening the False Claims Act and strengthen whistleblower protections.
promises.quote: I will keep fighting misguided efforts to water down Lincoln's Law and build on whistleblower protection laws across-the- board so truth-tellers don't fear reprisal.

promises.promise: Said he will keep working to permanently restore Title IX protections for women's sports.
promises.quote:
It is shameful that Democrats refuse to stand up for women and women’s sports.

This is far from over, and I will NEVER stop fighting to permanently restore Title IX protections.

promises.promise: Said he will vote no if Kash Patel's FBI Director nomination reaches the Senate floor.
promises.quote: Kash Patel is dangerous, dishonest, and unqualified – I am calling for President Trump to withdraw his nomination to be the Director of the FBI, and if his nomination is brought to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. Here’s why 🧵
promises.assessment: Said he'd vote no if the nomination reached the floor, and did. Assessed by Claude from public records.

evidence.description: Voted no on Kash Patel's confirmation as FBI Director (PN 1235). He was confirmed 51–49.

promises.promise: Said she and Senator Peters would introduce budget amendments to protect education funding.
promises.quote: That is why Senator Peters and I will be introducing a series of amendments to this massive, misguided budget proposal to fund a giveaway for billionaires at the expense of our kids.

promises.promise: Said she would vote against the HHS secretary nomination.
promises.quote: And tonight, I stand here for all of the children of our country, all of the families of our country, and I will be voting no on this nomination.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote no on the nomination and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as Secretary of Health and Human Services. He was confirmed 52–48.

promises.promise: Said she will work to ensure people fighting fentanyl have the resources they need.
promises.quote: I will work to make sure the people tasked with protecting the public from this poison have the resources they need to help.

promises.promise: Said she will continue to support Chris Wright's Energy Secretary nomination through confirmation.
promises.quote: We advanced Chris Wright’s nomination as Secretary of Energy in committee this morning, and I was proud to vote in support. I will continue to support him as he moves through the confirmation process.
promises.assessment: Voted to advance the nomination but missed the final confirmation vote. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted yes on cloture for Chris Wright's nomination as Secretary of Energy.
Did not vote on the final confirmation, which passed.

promises.promise: Said that as ranking member of the Military Construction and Veterans Affairs appropriations subcommittee he would work on national security and veterans' issues.
promises.quote: From this key position, I will strengthen U.S. national security and fight for Georgia’s veterans, servicemembers, and their families.

promises.promise: Said that as Small Business Committee chair she would reform the SBIR program to get small-business innovation to the military.
promises.quote:
The SBIR program needs to be reformed to ensure cutting-edge innovation from small businesses gets into the hands of warfighters.

As @SmallBizCmteGOP chair, I will make this happen.

promises.promise: Said he will vote against Pete Hegseth's nomination for Secretary of Defense on the Senate floor.
promises.quote: It is for these reasons that every Democrat on the Senate Armed Services Committee voted against advancing [Mr. Hegseth's] nomination, and I will oppose [Mr. Hegseth] on the floor.
promises.assessment: Promised to oppose the nomination on the floor and voted no. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on Pete Hegseth's confirmation as Secretary of Defense (PN 117). He was confirmed.

promises.promise: Said she would vote against confirming Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense.
promises.quote: For all these reasons and quite a few more, I will not be voting to confirm the extremely unqualified Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense.
promises.assessment: Said she'd vote against confirming Hegseth and did. Assessed by Claude from Senate roll-call records.

evidence.description: Voted no on confirming Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense. The vote tied 50–50 and the Vice President broke the tie to confirm him.

promises.promise: Said he would support the U.S. military’s mission under President Trump and Pete Hegseth.
promises.quote: Under President Trump and Pete's strong leadership, the U.S. military will once again become the world's most lethal fighting force that our enemies fear and our allies respect, and I will do everything I can to support their mission.

promises.promise: Said she would work to reduce the size of the federal government and speak against government spending.
promises.quote: As Florida’s next U.S. Senator, I will work tirelessly to reduce the bloat of Washington and speak out loudly against government spending.

promises.promise: Said he would continue work to protect and support law enforcement.
promises.quote: As chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, you can be sure that I will continue my work to protect and support law enforcement in both Iowa and nationwide.
